Experience storage.

Store the experience you build. Process it with one shared usage balance.

01 / EXPERIENCE STORAGE

Keep the experience you build.

Experience storage includes your saved content and graph data. Both count toward your plan’s storage allowance.

If experience storage fills up, existing memories remain readable. Clear space or upgrade to save more.

02 / PROCESSING & AGENT EXECUTION

Build on what you learn.

Your monthly credit covers experience processing and agent execution. Experience processing includes memory processing and Recipe iteration. CoSens-provided model calls draw from the same balance. Top up when you need more.

When your balance runs out, processing and agent execution that require this credit pause. Your plan does not become a time-limited trial.

Your team’s space grows with its paid members.

Team experience storage is the sum of paid members’ allowances. Free members can collaborate without adding capacity to the pool.

A few things to know.

Is Free a trial?

No. Free has no time limit. Capacity and usage allowances apply.

Does this replace my AI subscription?

No. Your ChatGPT or Claude subscription is separate. Model calls billed directly to your own provider account are paid there; CoSens-provided model calls use your shared monthly credit.

How are Recipe iterations limited?

Versions do not count as additional Recipes. Iteration draws from your experience processing balance rather than a separate iteration-count allowance. When the balance runs out, top up to continue.

Do I need Pro to collaborate?

No. Team collaboration is available on every plan. Shared experience storage comes from paid members.

How do I arrange a paid plan or add credit?

Email hello@cosens.ai to discuss plan access or top-ups. This website does not process subscription payments or top-ups. Contacting us does not activate a plan or charge your account.

Memory connections are available. Learn, the SDK and Recipe management are in preview. Recipe counts describe active custom Recipes, not versions or iteration limits.
